title: Outcome decision table
description: Human-authored (clinical drafter drafts, Hadas approves; outcome texts pass the lawyer). Evaluated by code. Order each turn: (1) red flags -> 5. (2) routing_stops (draft 3.4: evaluated in a flag turn too, where a TRUE stop or an unsettled flag_form_gate blocks the form while the screen stays S6; immediate_patterns run deterministically at step 2) (D-02: minor writing about self, non-parent reporting on a child, incl. a minor subject reached via 'someone else') -> fixed text, no form, no contact collected, content deleted. Both D-02 stops are mandatory (schema). Any form is blocked after a stop and after any red flag whose form_after_message is none (SEC-11). At the end of intake: (3) first rule by 'order' whose 'when' is TRUE; UNKNOWN never fires. (4) Guards: outcome 3 -> 2 unless outcome3_enabled (D-03: false at launch), no exclusion TRUE/UNKNOWN, every applicable critical slot filled, no conflict, every user message extracted at least once. Outcome 4 is NOT gated by critical slots (critic F5): it requires the domain filled and confirmed in the recap, no flag, and the outcome4_requirements of the domain answered (filled or unknown) - the policy asks those before deciding. (5) No rule -> default (always 2). would_be_outcome_3 (true/false/undetermined) is always computed and logged. Addenda attach extra lines. Outcome 5 cannot come from a rule.

outcome3_enabled.description: D-03: false at launch. would_be_outcome_3 is logged in every session either way.

outcome3_exclusions.description: Groups that never receive outcome 3 (e.g. certain ages). Evaluated conservatively: TRUE or UNKNOWN excludes.

3.description: Outcome 3 always carries the 'when to contact' signs and a form that stays available (GOALS.md). return_signs_text_id = the block shown always (outcome.3.when_to_contact.always); return_signs_conditional = per-domain wtc lists (REVIEW_FOR_HADAS section 5), all TRUE ones shown.

5.description: Outcome 5: the form visibility comes from the raised flag's form_after_message (D-04); this field is fixed to none. The disclaimer is mandatory and must be rendered on the S6 screen (L-19).

outcome4_requirements.description: REVIEW_FOR_HADAS table 4.4 (clinical section 9 outcome4_guard). Reachability is a build check, see if_applicable_slots.

answered_slots.description: Must be filled or unknown (not missing) before outcome 4. The goals that fill them are asked first.

applies_when.description: Optional extra scope of this row (e.g. social_communication: core_relation = child). Outside it the row does not apply and outcome 4 is not available through it (default 2, as matrix 1.12 says).

if_applicable_slots.description: Subset of answered_slots that count as met when NO goal filling them applies (the clinical 'אם חל', e.g. screen_neuro). Explicit only: every other answered slot must be filled or unknown. intake:check fails if a slot NOT listed here is unreachable for some combination of the routing enums under which the row applies (clinical 9.4 item 2; never a blanket 'goal not applicable = met' for safety_screen).

routing_stops.description: D-02. Evaluated every turn after red flags. A stop ends the conversation with a fixed text, never shows a form, never collects contact details, and deletes the session content at the end of the turn.

message_variants.description: First whose 'when' is TRUE replaces text_id. Draft 3.3: D-02 (gate 1) removed 101 and the helplines from the fixed minor texts (minor.self*; whether reporter.not_parent follows is open for Eliya); an emergency message appears only when a red flag is raised, and flags are checked before stops in every turn, so such a turn ends in S6, never in the stop. D-13 branch B: no age buttons, so a minor_self stop happens only after free text that the regex and the extractor already scanned; the before-text variant (minor.self.before_text) is used only with an ACTIVE self_age_band goal (branch A) and intake:check fails if a variant points to it while that goal is inactive.

immediate_patterns.description: Draft 3.4 (SEC5-08, SEC5-01): deterministic routing net. Runs at step 2 of every turn together with the red-flag scan, in the linear engine (re2js), under the same rules P1-P4 and inside the same 50/500 ms budget, on the masked text, with or without the model (also in degraded mode, where the extractor does not run, and in a turn whose flag came from an immediate pattern, where the text is not extracted). A match makes this stop's condition TRUE (source: pattern): S13 when no flag is raised, otherwise stop_conditions_met under S6 (no form). Only first-person, high-specificity statements; a false positive only removes the form (fail closed). Authored by the clinical drafter (5), approved by Hadas; the test fixture holds placeholders only.

test_phrases_he.description: Required with immediate_patterns, as for a red flag: positives must match, negatives must not (intake:check step 6).

allOf.description: SEC5-08 (draft 3.4): the minor_self stop must carry the deterministic net, so a minor who states their age is stopped also without the model (D-13 branch B has no age buttons).
Draft 3.4: patterns come with their test phrases.

extraction_gap_text_id.description: Critic F1(b): added to the outcome card (with 101) when a user message could not be extracted even after the retry.

flag_form_gate.description: Draft 3.4 (SEC5-01): after a red flag the conversation cannot continue, so routing gates that were still open (who writes about whom, the subject's age) will never be asked. The secondary form after an urgent-only flag is offered ONLY if this condition is TRUE (three-valued: UNKNOWN or FALSE = no form, blocked_reason routing_unsettled_under_flag), in addition to every flag allowing a form and no stop condition being TRUE. Mechanism: architect (closed list, engine/routingStops flagFormGate). Condition: clinical drafter (5), approved by Hadas. Architect's proposal: TRUE for core_relation self (self_declared_minor missing or false), for core_relation child with reporter_role parent, and for core_relation other_adult with subject_adult TRUE or core_age not applicable.

reason_label_he.description: Shown to Hadas only, never to the user.

include_generated_summary.description: Whether the warm LLM summary of what the user said is shown around the fixed text. Should be false for 5 if Hadas prefers the red-flag screen to stay fully fixed.

return_signs_conditional.description: Per-domain 'when to contact' lines for outcome 3, e.g. {when: {slot: domain, op: contains, value: voice}, text_id: when_to_contact.wtc_voice_persisting}. All TRUE entries are shown, in order, followed by return_signs_text_id.
